item.description:
### Added - **First-Open Accessibility Prompt** — explains on first launch which features use Accessibility (and what still works without it), with preview and reset controls in Developer Tools
### Changed - **Dashboard & Readability** — refreshed the Accessibility banner, increased card and text contrast across the Dashboard and settings, and renamed **Clean Lock** to **Keyboard Lock** with clearer copy
### Fixed - **Menu Bar & Multi-Display** — the status bar menu now stays open reliably when Toolbox is in the background, and the window opens on the display where your cursor is - **Clipboard Popover** — the search field auto-focuses on open so keys filter immediately (no alert beeps), arrow-key scrolling works in both directions, and closing the full-text preview with Left Arrow keeps your exact row and scroll position - **Port Killer** — the search box auto-focuses on open so you can type to filter or press `↓` to select rows immediately - **Call Controls** — in-app mute status syncs cleanly when joining calls, the **Also Mute macOS Hardware Mic** toggle works in all scopes, idle background chat windows no longer hijack mic/video toggles during an active Slack call, and the floating pill only appears during real calls - **DMG Installer** — removed white borders around the Finder window in the installer backdrop
